translation: Took place in posad Serock, 21 July 1890, 8 PM. Appeared personally Beniamin Hochberg, tavern keeper, 23, and Moszek Mitelbach, carter, 24, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 7 PM in posad Serock died a child named Dawid Ochberg[?], son of Szmil[?] and his wife Blima Dwojra nee Szafran, aged two years. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by them.
